name: FlyLong public balance-writing controls
summary: FlyLong exposes tokenMarketing() and tradingTake() to any low-BNB-balance caller, letting the attacker forge the pair's FlyLong balance inside a Pancake flash-swap callback and satisfy the pair's K check without repaying.
